name: application-filter-chip-overflow
title: Filter Chip Overflow
description: Row of removable active-filter chips that collapses extras beyond a visible count into a '+N more' trigger opening a popover with the rest.
useWhen: Users can apply many filters at once and the chip row would otherwise wrap awkwardly or crowd the toolbar.
You want every applied filter individually removable, including ones tucked into overflow.
The container has a fixed or narrow width where the number of visible chips needs to be capped.
avoidWhen: There are rarely more than 2-3 filters — just render all chips inline without an overflow trigger.
The filters need to stay in a fixed, unwrapping single row at all costs — this pattern intentionally wraps/collapses rather than truncating text.
You need the dropdown to add new filters, not just manage existing ones — pair this with data-filter-bar's 'Add filter' trigger instead.
responsiveBehavior: The chip row wraps naturally; pair `visibleCount` with a container query or resize observer in your own code to adjust how many chips show before collapsing to overflow.
accessibility: Each chip's remove button has a specific aria-label naming the filter it removes, not a generic 'Remove'.
The overflow trigger uses aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded reflecting the popover's open state.
The overflow popover is a role="dialog" region so its contents are grouped for assistive tech.

variants.title: Collapsed
variants.description: Three visible filter chips plus a '+3 more' trigger for the rest, each chip individually removable.
accessibility: Remove buttons are reachable by keyboard independent of the chip's own click target.

variants.title: Collapsed (Dark)
variants.description: Collapsed filter chip row adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Chip and remove-button colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Overflow open
variants.description: The '+3 more' trigger expanded, showing the remaining filters in a popover list, each also removable.
accessibility: aria-expanded="true" on the trigger is kept in sync with the popover's visible state.

variants.title: Overflow open (Dark)
variants.description: Open overflow popover state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Popover background and border colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
